title: A false `if` with no else falls through to the next command
why: Both the cheatsheet and the language reference promise "if true — jump, otherwise fall through". The Unity player routed the empty branch through SeekTo, where an empty label means __end — so a false condition SILENTLY ENDED THE CHAPTER. Our compiler always emits `else`, which is why it never bit; `.lvn` is advertised as a container any tool may write, so the runtime has to honour the documented rule.
